//: The judge/model panel. EDIT THIS FILE to change models - no code changes.
//1: Each 'slot' is 'provider/model'. Any provider/model named here is registered
//2: on the fly against that provider's API key.
//4: KEY INSIGHT: the native APIs (z.ai, moonshot) are the PAID side of those
//5: products - their free tier is the website chat, not the API, so they 429.
//6: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com) re-hosts the SAME frontier models on free
//7: credits. So we route all three top-tier judges through NVIDIA = free + working:
//9: - nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro  -> DeepSeek V4 Pro (free via NVIDIA NIM)
//10: - nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6        -> Kimi K2.6      (free via NVIDIA NIM)
//12: All need only NVIDIA_API_KEY. DeepSeek V4 Pro queues/stalls on NVIDIA's free
//13: tier - use async mode ({"async":true} + poll GET /api/jobs/<id>); the job just
//14: stays 'running' until it lands and never blocks the other judges.
//15: Native routes (zai/glm-5.1, moonshot/kimi-k2.6) stay in providers.py as PAID
//16: alternates; google/gemini-* is also wired if you add GOOGLE_API_KEY.

judges.note: DeepSeek V4 Pro via NVIDIA NIM (free; slow/queued - use async)
